mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 0.25%, it signals an imminent monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS growth) combined with weak industrial production (INDPRO decline) signals an overheating economy with supply constraints, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate Fed intervention.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where PAYEMS growth and INDPRO decline co-occur, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes marked by high housing starts (HOUST) and robust GDP growth (GDPC1), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as the market prices in an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of late-cycle expansion periods defined by HOUST > 450 and GDPC1 > 11300, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals improving labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods where UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0 (index 2017=100), it signals a weakening supply chain and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL) combined with strong labor market growth (PAYEMS) signals an overheating economy that prompts aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where CPIAUCSL rises and PAYEMS grows, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In supply shock regimes characterized by a sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns as investors anticipate reduced corporate profits and economic contraction over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: supply shock regime (INDPRO decline > 1% in 1 month)
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of supply shock regime periods, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
